title: Lamb Spanakopita Casserole
description: A French twist on the classic Greek dish, combining the flavors of lamb and spanakopita in a hearty casserole.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from skillet and set aside. Add onion and garlic to skillet and cook until onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add frozen spanakopita to skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine cooked lamb, spanakopita mixture, feta cheese, parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until lamb is cooked through.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
